claims.answer: Electron desktop app (macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, Linux x64), a React PWA served by the standalone server (usable from phone browsers), a `vibetree` CLI and the server API. No native iOS/Android app or editor extension. A Windows launch crash is reported (issue 136).

evidence.finding: macOS dmg+zip (x64, arm64), Windows NSIS x64, Linux AppImage and deb x64; publish null (no auto-update feed).

evidence.finding: shell:start/write/resize/status/get-buffer/terminate/get-agent-states and git:worktree:list/status/diff/diff:staged/worktree:add/remove messages; sessions persist when a connection closes.

evidence.finding: `vibetree worktrees list|add|remove`, `status`, `run <branch> ["prompt"]` with --server/--token/--project/--agent/--delay; uses the same REST and WebSocket APIs as the web app.

evidence.finding: `git worktree add -b <branch> ../<project>-<branch>` runs post-create hook; removal runs pre-remove hook, `git worktree remove --force` and `git branch -D`.

evidence.finding: HOST default 0.0.0.0, PORT 3002, AUTH_REQUIRED, VIBETREE_USERNAME/PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET default dev secret, SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS default 24h, ALLOW_INSECURE_LAN.

evidence.title: Auth service
evidence.finding: QR pairing generates a short-lived token exchanged for a device JWT with 7-day expiry; devices can be listed and revoked over REST.

evidence.title: Agent state tracker
evidence.finding: Derives idle/working/needs-input/done per terminal session from PTY traffic and user Enter input; broadcast to clients.

evidence.title: Agent activity patterns
evidence.finding: Regex heuristics for completion (send prompt) and questions ([Y/n], Do you want to proceed?) in terminal output; tuned to Claude Code style prompts.

evidence.finding: Native Electron notifications for completed and question states per worktree, with macOS permission handling.

evidence.title: Terminal command scheduler
